declarations.name: outputs.Proofs.FreyaParameterTuning.finite_batch_minimum
declarations.type_text:
∀ (p : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.Optimized),
  0 < p.m →
    1 ≤ outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.optimizedBatch p ∧
      outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.optimizedBatch p ≤ p.m ∧
        outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.batchObjective p (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.optimizedBatch p) =
          ⨅ j, outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.batchObjective p (↑j + 1)

declarations.name: outputs.Proofs.FreyaParameterTuning.optimized_comparison
declarations.type_text:
∀ (p : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.Optimized),
  0 < p.m →
    0 < p.n →
      0 ≤ p.Lminus →
        0 ≤ p.Lpm →
          Monotone p.τ →
            0 < outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime p.τ ↑p.m →
              outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime p.τ ↑p.m ≠ ⊤ →
                outputs.Proofs.FreyaParameterTuning.timeCoefficient p (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.optimizedBatch p)
                      (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.optimizedProbability p) ≤
                    2 * ⨅ j, outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.batchObjective p (↑j + 1) ∧
                  ∀ (S : ℕ),
                    0 < S →
                      ∀ (ρ : ℝ),
                        0 < ρ →
                          ρ ≤ 1 →
                            outputs.Proofs.FreyaParameterTuning.timeCoefficient p
                                (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.optimizedBatch p)
                                (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.optimizedProbability p) ≤
                              4 * outputs.Proofs.FreyaParameterTuning.timeCoefficient p S ρ
